definitionZh: -webkit-text-security是一个非标准的CSS属性,它通过用形状取代来混淆一个形式字段(如输入或文本区域)中的字符. 它只影响不是类型=密码字的字段.
sourceDefinition: -webkit-text-security is a non-standard CSS property that obfuscates characters in a form field (such as input or textarea) by replacing them with a shape. It only affects fields that are not of type=password.
